description: For founders and company staff: change a fact on your own company's listing (website, one-line description, headquarters, founded year, team size, LinkedIn, pricing page, product page, customers page). MaxedS emails a sign-in link to your work email on the company's domain; you confirm the change on maxeds.org and it shows immediately, marked as updated by the company. Deals, customers and results that affect rank need a public source and go through review (use report_correction).

source_url.description: Optional: a public link that shows the new value

work_email.description: Your work email on the company's domain; the sign-in link goes here

title: Update your company's SalesBook listing
